newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiamusi Paper to list 50 mln A shares on March 10.
newsitem.headline: Jiamusi Paper to list 50 mln A shares on March 10.

text.p: China's Jiamusi Paper Co Ltd said on Thursday it planned to list 50 million A shares in Shenzhen on Monday.
The A shares, launched on the Shenzhen bourse last month at 4.70 yuan each, were 252 times oversubscribed, the Shenzhen exchange has said.

Jiamusi Paper, which produces a broad variety of industrial paper, would use 228 million yuan in net proceeds expected to be raised from the offer to buy a paper factory, the company said in a recently-published prospectus.

In a listing annoucement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, Jiamusi said it now has 174.96 million outstanding shares, composed of 89.3 million state shares, 13.66 million legal person shares, 22 million staff shares and 50 million A shares.

The company, based in the northern province of Heilongjiang, forecast net profit of 34.6 million yuan for 1997, compared with 31.8 million yuan estimated for 1996 and 38.6 million yuan booked for 1995.
